hooks.command: if [ ! -d "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -d "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then mkdir -p ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco && ln -s "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs && echo "Symlinked Monaco from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-monaco.sh; fi; fi

WORKTREE_DIR=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["cwd"])') && cd "$WORKTREE_DIR" && if [ ! -d "ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then MAIN_WT=$(git worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/worktree //'); if [ -n "$MAIN_WT" ] && [ -d "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ]; then mkdir -p ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco && ln -s "$MAIN_WT/ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs" ConjureDSPExtension/Resources/monaco/vs && echo "Symlinked Monaco from main worktree"; else ./scripts/setup-monaco.sh; fi; fi
